name: Burst Resource Deployment
description: A sudden burst of virtual machines or deployments in Azure Activity is either a scaling event you expected or someone standing up miners, staging hosts, or ransomware infrastructure. One VM is a developer. Dozens in minutes in a subscription that is usually quiet is not. This is about volume and timing, not a single API name. Compare against change windows and known automation identities.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
